notes.title: Update V1.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/910c5d1472dcb08e42b19f3fc7fd0479b7a09e90.jpg[/img]

[h1]Westhunt - Update v1.4 Patch Notes[/h1]

We're excited to finally share with you the biggest and best updates in the West! Check below for our new features and bug fixes.

[h2]New Features:[/h2]

[h3][b]4v4 Mode (Custom Rooms Only)[/b][/h3]
Experience the intense action in our brand-new 4v4 mode, available exclusively in custom rooms. Gather your friends or team up with players from across the globe to conquer the Wild West in your own private showdowns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/43a6d5b2ec832e662b293dc5d5a71848a9ca4144.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Daily Login Rewards Enhanced[/b][/h3]
Each day brings new treasures! Just for logging in, you can now receive a variety of items to enhance your gameplay. Expect exclusive skins, sprays, and pets among your rewards.
Make sure to log in daily and collect your bounty to stand out in the crowd!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/f954349eaee2d0d4df68b3d3115882e49295a5bd.jpg[/img]

[h2]UI Updates: [/h2]

We've revamped the user interface for room creation, loading screens, and game over screen to support the new 4v4 mode, making it easier and more intuitive to set up your game exactly how you like it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/2d50ff1bcbbd3b985b72acc0ecdc6eeb6a53c503.png[/img]

Enhanced Game Over Screen: The game over screen now includes a new kill log, allowing you to see who landed the most shots and caused the most collateral damage. Analyze your game and plan your next move with better insights!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/1529c4960841f0607aca1cf3ca0cd945eb737e54.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes: [/h2]
We've dedicated this patch to crushing some pesky bugs hindering your gameplay.
Thanks to your invaluable feedback, we've implemented several fixes to enhance game stability and performance. 
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where outlaws could be detected through the outlines of other objects, ensuring a fairer stealth experience for all players.
[*]When the custom setting "Disable Sheriff's Outline" is enabled, the sheriff's icon will no longer appear on the minimap, maintaining the element of surprise in gameplay.
[*]Plus several minor bug fixes to enhance game stability and performance based on your feedback.
[/list]

Thank you for playing West Hunt! We are dedicated to continuously improving the game and value your support and feedback. 

Keep it coming and happy hunting!
- The West Hunt Development Team

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/efd859755aa4c15a2c218b50b2d724f65190d8e0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Happy Cinco de Mayo Westerners![/h1]

On September 12, 2022 we launched one of our favorite maps to date, Mexico City. We wanted to honor that map and Cinco de Mayo with our loyal player base! So to celebrate, launch into a West Hunt Game and play in the Mexico City Map with your best friends!

For those who might not be aware, Cinco de Mayo (Spanish for "Fifth of May") is a yearly celebration held on May 5 to celebrate Mexico's victory over the Second French Empire at the Battle of Puebla in 1862.

There’s no better time to celebrate than with a little friendly competition between community members, so share a screenshot of you playing in the Mexico City Map to the Screenshots section of the Steam forum! Doing so will enter you into a raffle to win 1 random item bundle key. Use [b]#WestHuntCincoDeMayo[/b] in your submission to be considered.

[*] Use hashtag [b]#WestHuntCincoDeMayo[/b] in your submission to be considered
[*] Once winners are announced you have 30 days to respond to the ww_cm account to receive your keys
[/list]

Get your running boots on, because Outlaws will now have the ability to run for up to 10s after successfully completing a task. Careful when you use it!

We're also excited to add more custom game parameters for our community as well! You'll soon be able to invite more friends to join in on the fun with 3v3 and 3v2 options in Custom Games!

Exclusive skins will soon be available for content creators of different platforms! Stay tuned for more details on how to get them!

In addition to all these exciting new features will come some balancing updates as well! 

And don’t forget you can come up with your own custom alias in your profile for only a few coins. You have enough from robbing the bank right?

All in all it’s looking mighty lively in the Old West, and Mexico City has plenty to offer if you’re ready to shoot your shot.

[list]

[list]

[*] Sound Distraction: Outlaw can make distracting 3D sounds, like a whistle or a fart to taunt the Sheriff. It can be very useful in 2vs2 and 3vs3 games, especially if you make those sounds in a crowd of NPCs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/f3746c94161fabf76e10711c82a9f42241c4f317.jpg[/img]

West Hunt is an online social deduction game set in the Old West. It's the perfect game to test your detective and stealth skills with your friends in quick, exciting matches.

West Hunt is set to release on June 14th, 2022. Be one of the first to get an exclusive look at the game in the Pre-Release West Hunt Invitational!

[h1]Event Info:[/h1]
The event is a 2-day Leaderboard race that will require competitors to stream on Twitch while participating. Players will queue up against each other in matchmaking during the Active Leaderboard period to score points for placement. 

[h3][b]Viewer Information[/b][/h3]
Viewers can follow along the Wild West action on any participating stream on Twitch! 
[b]Once the Tournament is live, you can find active participating channels on the West Hunt Twitch page here: https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/West%20Hunt[/b]

[h3][b]Twitch Drops[/b][/h3]
Twitch Drops will be available for viewers to earn exclusive titles, emotes, and skins!!

[h3][b]Tournament Details[/b][/h3]
[b]Date:[/b] June 11th - June 12th 
[b]Time: [/b]Leaderboard will be active 12pm EST - 6pm EST for both days

[h3][b]Prize Pool Distribution:[/b][/h3]
[b]Sheriff: [/b]
1st: $1,000 
2nd: $700 
3rd: $500

[b]Outlaw: [/b]
1st: $1,000 
2nd: $700
3rd: $500

[b]Best in the West Award:[/b]
$200 each to Three Winners
Best Moment/Funny Clip or Highlight

*Players are eligible to win twice if they place on both Leaderboards.

If you're interested in participating, please sign up here:
https://noiz.gg/quests/West-Hunt-Invitational-2022-Key-Quest-and-Prize-Pool

Have Questions? Looking for people to play with? Join us on West Hunt’s Official Discord here: https://discord.gg/wZguJeZg5v

DM the Tournament Director at Charizard#4090 to receive the “Pardner” role for access to Tournament Channels, and if you have any questions at all! 


See you out on the West!
